text:
Ana Gomez: Noticed a weird UX during the last canary: per-route cost sparkline drops to 0 for routes that hit the prefetch cache. Screenshot incoming.
Ravi Patel: @Ana drop the screenshot. Which dashboard view?
Ana Gomez: Top-level route summary -> marginal-cost column. Seems only during the canary when router flips to variant-b we show 0.
Jules Kim: Likely because ingest marks prefetch_replay and we filter those from cost aggregates. We did that to avoid double-counting earlier.
Ravi Patel: Right, but that hides amortized cost. Product teams expect a gross vs net option. Zero is alarming.
Ana Gomez: UX suggestion: default view = net cost (post-credits) but show a faint dotted line for gross cost. Hover should list sample_count and sampling_rate.
Jules Kim: Implementation: add fields to econ_event v2: route_variant, effective_unit_cost, credit_reason, sampling_rate, sample_count. Consumers can compute cost = tokens * COALESCE(effective_unit_cost, unit_cost).
Ravi Patel: Agree. Also emit credit_reason values: "prefetch_hit", "prefetch_replay", "router_fallback", "model_quantized" so UI can break down why cost changed.
infra-bot: infra-bot: Canary job scheduled: cost-ingest-v2 -> zone-a at 2024-07-02T18:00Z
Ana Gomez: If we change ingest, queries will need to switch from SUM(tokens * unit_cost) to SUM(tokens * COALESCE(effective_unit_cost, unit_cost)). Can we keep a compat flag for older dashboards?
Jules Kim: We can. Add a feature_flag: econ_events_v2_consumption. Dashboard toggles to opt-in before full rollout.
Ravi Patel: Also we need a low-sample warning when sample_count < 50 for the selected time window. Show: "Estimate noisy: low sample (N)" and gray out the sparkline.
Ana Gomez: Good call. We'll add small copy: "Values estimate net cost by extrapolating sampled prefetch credits."
Jules Kim: Backend notes: ingestion will attach sampling_rate at emit time to avoid joins; consumers should not recompute sampling_rate by dividing distinct counts.
Ravi Patel: Telemetry request: keep raw econ_events for at least 30 days during rollout and add reconciliation job to compare new aggregates vs old logic.
infra-bot: infra-bot: Retention override applied: raw-econ-events = 30d for rollout namespaces.
Ana Gomez: Action items: Jules -> proto PR + migration notes; Ravi -> reconciliation job and consumer adapters; Ana -> dashboard mockups + copy + feature flag wiring.
Jules Kim: I'll send the proto diff and open the PR today. Will include a tiny SQL example for the dashboard.
Ravi Patel: SQL sketch for dashboard change: ```SELECT route, route_variant, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(tokens * COALESCE(effective_unit_cost, unit_cost)) AS net_cost, SUM(tokens * unit_cost) AS gross_cost, AVG(sampling_rate) AS avg_sampling, SUM(sample_count) AS sample_count FROM econ_events WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end GROUP BY route, route_variant;```
Ana Gomez: Thanks. Let's avoid surprising customers with disappearing costs mid-canary.
Ravi Patel: Agreed. I'll also add a console-level toggle: "Show gross cost" so engineers can flip for debugging.
Jules Kim: One more: include a short changelog note and migration guide in the proto PR so downstream teams know to handle COALESCE semantics.
Ana Gomez: Perfect. I'll share the mockup here once it's uploaded.
Ravi Patel: :thumbsup:
